title: Redaction parity, honest test rows, run ownership and held quality
goal: the query-log redactor catches a long token after an equals sign and the common cloud key shapes; a test.run row says whether the run breached, against which limit and on how many workers and tests.py --changed sees a rename out of _tools; claim and land refuse when coord answers that another owner holds the item's run and stay fail-open when coord is silent; every sprint review holds the held-out fitness rate at 86 of 99 with at most 8 false good; the kb's docs say which authority boundaries are enforced and which are convention, with two free experiments; three small paid probes settle the code map's docs-map result, the cost of concurrent same-article research and the distill model's name recall
